cases.name: detected snowflake (QUALIFY), two findings
cases.sql:
SELECT *
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.customer_id ORDER BY o.created_at DESC) = 1

findings.message: SELECT * fans out columns and disables column pruning. List columns explicitly.
Join detected without BROADCAST hint. If one side is small (< ~8MB), broadcast it.
